prompt: 我们分析完了，核心问题是游戏缺少反馈循环——玩家的行为不影响世界状态，所以叙事和机制是脱节的。方向是：需要一个机制让玩家的订单完成和物品处理产生世界层面的后果。给我几个具体方案。

assertions.description: Each proposal has all required sections (想法/规则变更/分析)
Rule changes specify actual modifications (not abstract concepts)
Proposals reference actual game systems accurately
Each proposal's 想法 section explicitly names the problem (feedback loop) and explains the causal chain of how it solves it
Proposals use plain descriptive language, not invented compound nouns or coined terms
When proposals add new systems, they justify why. Simpler proposals exist alongside complex ones.
Analysis addresses whether the proposal risks hurting existing fun with explicit tradeoff reasoning
